library.title: Your library is empty
library.description: Matane Anime comes with no sources. Add an extension repository from someone you trust, install the sources you want, then add anime to follow them here.

add.title: Add a repository
add.body: Paste the URL of an extension repository. Matane Anime checks its signature and tells you if it is not trusted.

install.title: Install sources
install.body: Pick the extensions you want. Each one runs in a sandbox and goes through the app for every request.

watch.title: Watch and follow
watch.body: Open an anime, press play, and add it to your library to get new-episode alerts.

library.notice: Matane Anime does not host or distribute any video. Sources are chosen and added by you.

updates.title: No new episodes
updates.description: New episodes of the anime in your library show up here as they come out.

history.title: Nothing watched yet
history.description: Episodes you start watching appear here, one entry per anime.

sources.title: No sources installed
sources.description: Sources come from extensions. Add a repository in Extensions, then install the ones you want.

globalSearch.title: Search every source at once
globalSearch.description: Install a source first, then search all of them from here.

downloads.title: No downloads
downloads.description: Episodes you download for offline viewing show up here, with their progress.

anime.title: Anime not found
anime.description: This anime is not in your library yet.

watch.title: Nothing is playing
watch.description: The player arrives in the next phase.

system.title: System
system.runAtLoginHint: Lets update checks and downloads run in the background.
system.closeToTrayHint: The window hides instead of quitting. On Linux, the tray needs a desktop that supports AppIndicator.

general.amoledHint: Makes the dark themes black, for OLED screens. Not available in Latte.

nsfw.title: Show 18+ sources
nsfw.description: Off by default. Hides adult extensions in the repository list, browse and global search.

contentLanguage.title: Content language
contentLanguage.hintAll: No language selected: sources in every language are offered.
contentLanguage.hintSome: Only sources in the selected languages are offered (and multi-language ones).

advanced.loadHint: Load an extension from its folder to develop it. It reloads when you rebuild it.
advanced.devModeHint: Shows loading an extension from a folder and the extended extension log.

player.autoplayHint: A countdown starts when an episode ends, and you can cancel it.
player.countdownHint: How long to wait before the next episode starts.
player.qualityHint: Used to pick the first stream. You can always change it in the player.
player.seekHint: Back and Forward jump this far; the long jumps (J and L) go twice as far.
player.thresholdHint: An episode counts as watched once you pass this point. Going back does not undo it. At the end, only a finished video counts.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Change opens a key recorder: press the new key, or Esc to cancel. Changing an action replaces all of its keys.
shortcuts.conflict: {{combo}} is already used for "{{action}}". Change that one first.

library.categoriesHint: Group your library however you like. An anime can be in several categories, or none.
library.deleteBody: The anime in it stay in your library.
library.updatesEveryHint: Also runs when the app starts if the time has passed. Waits while you are offline.
library.updatesSkip: Skip these when checking the whole library or a category
library.skipHint: Checking a single anime always ignores these rules.
library.autoDownloadHint: Off by default. Uses the quality set in Downloads and stops at your size limit.
library.autoDownloadRule: Click a category to include it, again to exclude it. When any category is included, only those are downloaded. Exclude always wins.

downloads.folderHint: Moving the folder offers to move the episodes already downloaded. Each episode is saved under its source and anime name. Streams that arrive as segments are saved as a folder with a playlist; single files are saved as one MP4.
downloads.qualityHint: Closest available when exact is missing.
downloads.episodesAtOnceHint: Each source's rate limit still applies.
downloads.aheadHint: Saves the next episodes of anime in your library.
downloads.deleteAfterHint: Removes a downloaded episode once it is watched and the next one has been too.
downloads.keepCategoriesHint: Anime in a checked category keep their downloads after watching.
downloads.limitHint: When downloads pass the limit, automatic downloads stop and manual ones ask first. Matane Anime also checks free disk space before each download starts.

data.coverCacheHint: Covers from browsing and search are kept on disk so they show at once the next time. Covers of your library are kept apart and never removed.
data.watchHistoryHint: Removes the History page entries. Progress and watch time stay.
data.watchTimeHint: Removes recorded watch sessions. History and progress stay.
data.clearStatsBody: Your watch time, streak and charts start over. Your library, watched episodes and history stay.

network.intro: For sources your internet provider blocks. Changes apply right away, without restarting.
network.httpsOnly: The address must start with https://
network.systemHint: Uses the proxy of your system, if it has one.
network.portInvalid: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
network.needsLogin: The proxy needs a username and password
network.socksLogin: Chromium cannot send a username and password to a SOCKS5 proxy; use an HTTP proxy if yours needs a login.
network.passwordStorage: Passwords are stored in your system keyring when there is one. If there isn't, they are stored as plain text and this page says so.
network.plainWarning: There is no system keyring here, so the proxy password is stored as plain text in the app's database.
network.userAgentHint: By default, requests look like a current Chrome browser. Extensions may set their own.
network.agentInvalid: The User-Agent can only use printable ASCII characters.

about.channelHint: Beta also offers pre-releases. The choice applies to the next update check.
about.channelFailed: Could not change the update channel
about.licenseBody: Matane Anime is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. You may use, study, share and change it under the terms of that license. It comes without any warranty.

sources.title: Sources
sources.urlPlaceholder: Paste the address of an anime page
sources.notRecognized: None of your sources recognizes this address.

empty.title: No results
empty.description: Nothing matched. Try another search or fewer filters.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: Browsing needs a connection. Your library and history keep working.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.HttpError: The site answered with an error ({{status}}).
errors.CloudflareError: The site is guarding itself with a security check.
errors.RateLimitedError: The site asked us to slow down. Try again in a moment.
errors.NotFoundError: The site no longer has this.
errors.ParseError: The site changed and the extension could not read it.
errors.timeout: The extension took too long to answer.
errors.interrupted: The extension got stuck and was stopped.
errors.memory: The extension used too much memory and was stopped.
errors.host_crashed: The extension process stopped. Try again.
errors.invalid_result: The extension returned something the app cannot use.

main.repoAddressInvalid: That is not a valid address. Use a link like https://example.org/repo/
main.repoAddressScheme: A repository address must start with http:// or https://.
main.repoAddressCredentials: A repository address must not contain a user name or password.
main.repoNotSigned: This repository is not signed, so there is no key to trust.
main.repoNoKeyToTrust: This repository has no valid signature, so there is no key to trust.
main.repoGone: That repository is no longer in the list.
main.repoSignatureInvalid: The signature of this repository does not match its index. It may have been tampered with, so it was not added.
main.repoSignatureRemoved: The repository is trusted but its index is no longer signed. The new index was refused.
main.repoKeyChanged: The repository is now signed with a different key than the one you trusted. The new index was refused; remove the repository and add it again to trust the new key.
main.repoWentBack: The repository went back in time (serial {{serial}}, last accepted {{accepted}}). The old index was kept.
main.tooLarge: The size of {{subject}} is over the limit.
main.hashMismatch: The download does not match the SHA-256 in the repository index, so it was not installed.
main.sizeMismatch: The download does not have the size the index promises. {{detail}}
main.iconMismatch: The icon does not match the size and SHA-256 in the index.
main.manifestMismatch: The package contradicts the repository index. {{detail}}
main.badArchive: The package is not a valid extension archive. {{detail}}
main.packageTooLarge: The package is larger than allowed. {{detail}}
main.indexInvalid: The repository index could not be used. {{detail}}
main.extensionNotOffered: That extension is no longer offered by the repository.
main.installExpired: This install request expired. Start the install again.
main.installRepoRemoved: The repository was removed in the meantime.
main.notFromRepo: "{{id}}" was not installed from a repository, so it has no updates.
main.repoOfExtensionRemoved: The repository this extension came from was removed, so it has no updates.
main.repoNoLongerOffers: The repository no longer offers this extension.
main.installedFromFolder: This extension is loaded from a folder; remove the folder instead.
main.devFolderRunning: A dev folder is running this extension. Remove the folder first.
main.apiTooNew: "{{name}}" needs extension API {{required}}; this app supports up to {{supported}}. Update the app to install it.
main.appTooOld: "{{name}}" needs Matane Anime {{version}} or newer. Update the app to install it.
main.devFolderBlocksInstall: "{{id}}" is loaded from a dev folder. Remove the folder before installing it from a repository.
main.installedFromOtherRepo: "{{id}}" is already installed from {{repo}}. An extension id can come from one repository at a time; uninstall it first.
main.installedFromAnotherRepo: "{{id}}" is already installed from another repository. An extension id can come from one repository at a time; uninstall it first.
main.invalidExtensionId: The extension id is not valid.
main.writeFailed: Could not write the extension files: {{detail}}
main.loadFailed: "{{name}}" could not be loaded, so nothing was changed. {{detail}}

anime.noEpisodes: This source lists no episodes yet.
anime.viewSaveFailed: Could not save the sort and filters of this anime

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.emptyDescription: Matane Anime ships with no sources. To get some, add the address of an extension repository from someone you trust, then install the extensions you want.
extensions.reinstallHint: Its files were changed after it was installed, so it was not loaded. Reinstall it from the repository, or uninstall it.
extensions.uninstallBody: Its sources and the anime you followed from them stay in your library. They show as "not installed" until you install the extension again.
extensions.shadowed: A folder with the same id is loaded instead of this installed copy.
extensions.alsoOffered: Also offered by {{repos}}, which stays uninstalled

incompatible.api: Needs a newer extension API than this app supports. Update the app to install it.
incompatible.app: Needs a newer version of Matane Anime. Update the app to install it.

conflict.dev: A folder you loaded already provides this extension. Remove the folder to install it from here.
conflict.repo: Already installed from {{repo}}. Uninstall it first to install it from here.

noneInstalled.title: Nothing installed yet
noneInstalled.description: Install an extension from your repositories to get sources to browse.

noneAvailable.title: Nothing to install
noneAvailable.description: Your repositories offer nothing that matches the Language and 18+ filters. Change them above, or check the repositories for news.

noRepos.title: No repositories yet
noRepos.description: Extensions come from repositories that you add. Press Add repository and paste the address of one from someone you trust.

extensions.removeRepoBody: The extensions you installed from it stay installed and keep working. You will not get their updates from it any more.

addRepo.title: Add repository
addRepo.description: Paste the address of an extension repository. Matane Anime reads its list and checks who signed it.
addRepo.unverifiedBody: This repository is not signed with a key you trust. You can still add it, but installing from it will show a warning every time.
addRepo.trustKeyHint: Installs and updates from this repository stop showing the warning. Only do this for people you know.
addRepo.unsignedBody: This repository has no signature, so nobody vouches for what it serves. You can still add it, but installing from it will show a warning every time.
addRepo.notice: Matane Anime does not suggest or ship any repository. Add only ones from people you trust.

installDialog.title: Install {{name}}
installDialog.sandbox: This extension runs in a sandbox. It can ask for pages from any website, and every request goes through Matane Anime, which applies rate limits. It cannot read your files.

unverified.title: Unverified repository
unverified.body: Nobody you trust vouches for this repository. Install only if you know who runs it. Signing key:

unsigned.title: Unsigned repository
unsigned.body: This repository has no signature, so nobody vouches for what it serves. Install only if you know who runs it.

nsfw.title: 18+ content
nsfw.body: This extension is marked 18+. It can offer adult sources, which stay hidden unless Show 18+ sources is on.

noUpdates.title: Everything is up to date
noUpdates.description: When a repository offers a newer version of an installed extension, it shows up here.

logs.title: Log of {{name}}
logs.description: What this extension logged, its failed calls and requests. New lines appear as they come.

extensions.preferencesHint: Changes are saved as you make them.

player.switchNote: Switching keeps your position. Your choice is remembered for this anime.

expired.title: This stream has expired
expired.body: The server refused the request. Retry, or switch to another server. Your place is kept.

network.title: Could not load the video
network.body: The connection to the server failed. Retry, or switch to another server.

codec.title: This video cannot be shown
codec.body: The format is not supported on this computer: the sound may play without a picture. Try another server.

noStream.title: No server answered
noStream.body: This episode has no working stream right now. Try again in a moment.

generic.title: Playback stopped
generic.body: Something went wrong while playing. Retry, or switch to another server.

library.removeBody: Their progress and history stay; you can add them again later.
library.noCategories: You have no categories yet. Make one below, or skip it: categories are optional.

noResults.title: Nothing matches
noResults.description: Try another search or fewer filters.

emptyCategory.title: This category is empty
emptyCategory.description: Add anime to it from an anime page or with Select.

library.viewSaveFailed: Could not save how this list looks

history.clearBody: This removes the list only. Your library, your progress and what you have watched stay as they are.
history.explainer: One entry per anime, showing the last episode you opened. Clearing history does not remove your library, progress or downloads.

noResults.title: Nothing matches
noResults.description: No entry in your history matches that search.

globalSearch.title: Global search
globalSearch.verify: Verification needed. The site wants a browser check.
globalSearch.noSources: There are no sources to search yet. Load an extension first.
globalSearch.hint: Type a title and press Enter.
globalSearch.noneWithResults: No source has results for this search.
globalSearch.noScope: There are no sources for this language or choice. Pick other sources or another language.

migrate.title: Migrate to another source
migrate.description: Find "{{title}}" on another source and keep what you watched.
migrate.noOtherSources: There is no other source to migrate to.
migrate.summary: {{matched}} of {{total}} episodes with progress match by number and will carry over.
migrate.nothingToCarry: Nothing was watched yet, so only the library entry moves.
migrate.unmatched_one: {{count}} episode with progress has no match and will lose it:
migrate.unmatched_other: {{count}} episodes with progress have no match and will lose it:
migrate.note: Your library entry, categories and history move to the new anime. The old one stays out of your library.

downloads.noneDownloaded: No episode of this anime is downloaded yet.

storage.title: Storage used by downloads
storage.note: Auto-download pauses at the limit. Manual downloads ask first.

folder.moveBody: The episodes downloaded so far can move to the new folder, or stay where they are. New downloads go to the new folder either way.

row.reorderHint: Drag to reorder, or use the arrow keys

completed.heading: Completed ({{count}})
completed.title: Completed downloads
completed.deleteBody: The files of this episode of {{title}} are removed from your computer. The episode stays in your library.

errors.live: This is a live stream, which cannot be downloaded.
errors.no_stream: The source has no stream to download for this episode.
errors.no_extension: The extension of this source is not installed.
errors.unsupported_encryption: This stream uses an encryption Matane Anime cannot download.
errors.size_limit: Downloading this would pass your size limit.
errors.disk_space: There is not enough free space on the drive.
errors.write_failed: Could not write to the download folder.
errors.disk_full: The drive ran out of space.
errors.expired: The stream link expired and could not be renewed.
errors.network: The connection dropped too many times.
errors.unreachable: The site could not be reached.
errors.redirect: The site redirected to something that is not a web address.
errors.file_missing: The downloaded files are gone from the disk, so this episode streams instead.
errors.reused: What was already saved is reused on retry.

enqueue.existing_one: That episode is already downloaded or queued
enqueue.existing_other: Those episodes are already downloaded or queued

refusals.disk_space: There is not enough free space on the drive.
refusals.no_extension: The extension of this source is not installed.
refusals.no_stream: The source has no stream to download.

limit.title: This passes your size limit
limit.body_one: Downloading {{count}} more episode would go past your {{limit}} limit ({{used}} used). Download anyway?
limit.body_other: Downloading {{count}} more episodes would go past your {{limit}} limit ({{used}} used). Download anyway?

library.none: Everything unwatched is already downloaded or queued.
library.body_one: The unwatched episodes of {{count}} selected anime will be queued.
library.body_other: The unwatched episodes of {{count}} selected anime will be queued.

queue.title: The queue is empty
queue.description: Episodes you download show up here while they wait or run.

completed.title: Nothing downloaded yet
completed.description: Finished downloads stay here, ready to watch offline.

errors.title: No errors
errors.description: Downloads that fail are listed here, with the reason.

updates.markAllBody_one: This marks {{count}} new episode as watched and takes it off this list.
updates.markAllBody_other: This marks all {{count}} new episodes as watched and takes them off this list.
updates.loadFailed: Could not load the new episodes

refused.size_limit: Not downloaded: it would pass your size limit.
refused.disk_space: Not downloaded: there is not enough free space.
refused.no_extension: Not downloaded: the source's extension is not installed.
refused.live: Not downloaded: this is a live stream.
refused.no_stream: Not downloaded: the source offers no stream for it.

updates.failedDetails: These anime could not be reached in the last check.
updates.seenAllBody_one: This takes {{count}} new episode off this list and the badge. It stays unwatched and its progress is kept.
updates.seenAllBody_other: This takes all {{count}} new episodes off this list and the badge. They stay unwatched and their progress is kept.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.label: Search the app
palette.placeholder: Search your library, jump to a page, or run an action

onboarding.saved: Each choice is saved as you go. You can change all of it later in Settings.

language.title: Make it yours
language.description: Pick the language of the app and how it looks. You can change both at any time.

content.title: Which languages do you watch in?
content.description: Sources and extensions in other languages stay hidden, so lists and search stay short. Change this any time in Settings, General.
content.noSources: Matane Anime comes with no sources. This only filters the ones you add yourself.

folder.title: Where should downloads go?
folder.description: Episodes you download are saved here so you can watch them offline. A single episode can take several hundred megabytes.
folder.limitHint: Automatic downloads stop at this size. You can change it in Settings, Downloads.

player.title: Your keyboard is the remote
player.description: These shortcuts work in the player. You can change how far the arrow keys jump in Settings, Player.
player.thresholdAt: Episodes count as watched at {{percent}}%, so you can skip the credits. You always pick up where you stopped.
player.thresholdEnd: Episodes count as watched when they end. You always pick up where you stopped.

whatsNew.title: What’s new
whatsNew.description: What changed in the version you are running.
whatsNew.none: There are no release notes for version {{version}} yet.

incognito.pillHint: Incognito is on. Click to turn it off.
incognito.body: What you watch now is not saved to history, progress or watch time. Marking episodes as watched and managing your library still work.
incognito.offBody: What you watch is saved to history, progress and watch time.

backup.description: One file with your library, categories, progress, history and settings. It does not include downloaded episodes, extensions or sign-in tokens.
backup.restoreBody: Your current library, progress, history and settings are replaced by this backup, and Matane Anime restarts. A copy of your current data stays in the app data folder.
backup.openFailed: Could not open the backup folder

auto.label: Automatic backups
auto.hint_one: Written to the backup folder while the app runs. The newest {{count}} are kept; backups you make yourself are never removed.
auto.hint_other: Written to the backup folder while the app runs. The newest {{count}} are kept; backups you make yourself are never removed.

backup.noneYet: No backups yet. Use Back up now, or turn on automatic backups.

empty.title: No statistics yet
empty.description: Watch an episode in the player and your time, streak and favourites show up here.
